verdict.rationale: The official developer portal announces an Anytype CLI that runs Anytype as a headless server for automation and scripting, which fits the AI-native story. The official agents skill also lets agent tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI run scripts against Anytype data, reinforcing the scripting workflow. Missing for 10: CLI command reference or install/usage docs, details on agent-oriented features (e.g. structured/JSON output), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the CLI works as described.
